description: SSH command/response contract at edge and authorized kernel origins. Public readiness is exercised against loopback TLS; manifest/site stdout is supplied unchanged by edge.sh. Test-only stream certificate, never a deployment identity.

argv: nginx_dir={NGINX_DIR}; cat "$nginx_dir/edge/manifest" 2>/dev/null; echo @@sites; for f in "$nginx_dir"/sites-available/* "$nginx_dir"/edge/stream/*.conf; do head -n 1 "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^# rendered by tools/bringup/edge.sh" && cat "$f"; done; true
timeout 10 openssl s_client -connect 10.0.0.7:9443 -servername stream.bringup.test </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 2>/dev/null

'tls={TLS_DIR}/human-event-client' app=internal-kms group=kms limit=10 url=https://internal-kms.railway.internal:9443/readyz 'connect=internal-kms.railway.internal:9443:{PRIVATE_TARGET}' sh -c 'for group in "$group"; do
	status=0
	answer=$(curl -sS -m "$limit" --cacert "$tls/ca.pem" --cert "$tls/cert.pem" --key "$tls/key.pem" -w "\n%{http_code}" "${url}" ${connect:+--connect-to "$connect"} 2>&1) || status=$?
	echo "@@$group $status $(printf "%s" "$answer" | tail -n 1) $(printf "%s" "$answer" | head -n 1 | tr -d " " | cut -c1-120)"
done'
